recommended_action: Check soil moisture. If dry, irrigate lightly.
precaution: Do not apply heavy nitrogen fertilizer without soil testing.

recommended_action: Inspect the underside of leaves. Consult local KVK for neem sprays.
Remove affected leaves. Ensure proper spacing.
Drain excess water. Apply zinc sulphate if advised.
precaution: Do not flood the field continuously.

recommended_action: Improve drainage. Allow soil to dry slightly.
Water at the base, not on leaves.
precaution: Do not water leaves in the evening.

recommended_action: Apply phosphorus-rich fertilizer if soil test confirms deficiency. Protect young plants from extreme cold.
precaution: Do not overwater the field during early growth stages.
